features.title: Features
features.heading: Light, moving shadows and everyday sounds — so from the street, someone is home.
features.lede: For anyone whose home sits empty during the day, on holiday or between visits: Kevin plays the three signs of life a burglar checks for, from one plug-in device. No camera, no microphone, and it keeps running when Wi-Fi is jammed.

seo.title: Kevin features: light, moving shadows and sound from one device | Mitipi
seo.description: What Kevin does: warm light scenes, patented moving shadows and 70+ hours of household sounds from 32 GB on-device storage. No camera, no microphone, jammer-resilient. Swiss-engineered, 9 W.

blocks.heading: Burglars check for light, movement and sound. Kevin gives them all three.
blocks.body: Every scene plays from the device itself and is visible and audible where it counts: from the pavement, through the curtains, at the front door.

blocks.image_alt: Kevin light scene visible through a window
blocks.title: Light that behaves like people
blocks.body: Warm light shifts the way real lamps and a flickering TV do. Not one lamp on a timer at the same time every night, but a room that looks in use.

blocks.image_alt: Moving shadow silhouette projected on a wall behind curtains
blocks.title: Shadows that move
blocks.body: Patented moving silhouettes cross the wall or ceiling behind your curtains. From outside it reads as one or more people walking through the room.

blocks.title: The sounds of a normal evening
blocks.body: Conversation, the TV, cooking, a dog that barks when the doorbell rings. 70+ hours of built-in scenes, up to four weeks without repeating, plus your own recordings. Built-in voices are in English, German and Swiss German.

blocks.heading: An alarm reacts once the door is tested. Kevin works before anyone tries.
blocks.body: Cameras record what already happened and can go dark when Wi-Fi is jammed. Kevin makes the house look occupied from outside, so the attempt never starts. Keep your alarm; put prevention in front of it.

blocks.image_alt: Jammed Wi-Fi cameras go dark while Kevin keeps playing from local storage
blocks.title: Keeps playing when Wi-Fi is jammed
blocks.body: Cheap jamming devices cut cameras and app alarms off the network. Kevin stores every scene on 32 GB inside the device and only uses Wi-Fi or Bluetooth for setup and updates. Light, shadow and sound continue without a signal.

blocks.image_alt: Kevin next to an existing alarm panel
blocks.title: Works alongside your alarm
blocks.body: Alarms and cameras detect. Kevin deters. It is honest about its limits: it will not call anyone or record anything. It makes an empty home look and sound lived-in, which is the layer most security setups are missing.

blocks.overline: Made in Switzerland, made for privacy
blocks.heading: No camera. No microphone. Nothing streamed.
blocks.body: Engineered and designed in Switzerland. Kevin projects light, shadow and sound; it never watches or listens. Plug it in near a window with a wall or ceiling for shadows, pair once, and it is ready. Typical use around 9 watts.

blocks.title: Useful when you are home, too
blocks.body: Between trips, Kevin works as a Bluetooth speaker and a lamp, so it earns its place by the window all year. Three buttons on the device start the essentials without the app.

features.cta_subheading: Buy Kevin outright: free shipping across the EU, 30-day returns, 3-year Swiss warranty.

how-it-works.heading: Plug in by the window, set it once, and your home looks lived-in every time you leave.
how-it-works.lede: For commuters, travellers and second-home owners: Kevin runs on a weekly schedule or switches on by itself when your phone leaves the area. Light, shadow and sound play from the device, so it keeps working when Wi-Fi is jammed.

seo.title: How Kevin works: plug in, schedule, leave | Mitipi

blocks.heading: Plug in. Choose a routine. Leave.
blocks.body: No installation, no wiring, no monitoring contract. Kevin needs a power socket, a window that faces the street and a wall or ceiling for shadows.

blocks.title: Plug in and place
blocks.body: Set Kevin near a window that is visible from outside, with a wall or ceiling behind it for shadows. Connect the power adapter. Three buttons on the device start the essentials without the app.

blocks.title: Set a schedule or use geofencing
blocks.body: In the Kevin app, set a weekly schedule once, or switch on geofencing so Kevin starts by itself when your phone leaves the area. Leaving in a hurry no longer matters.

blocks.title: Your home looks lived-in
blocks.body: Warm light, moving silhouettes and everyday sounds play from the 32 GB inside the device, varying for up to four weeks without repeating. Nothing streams from the cloud, so a jammed Wi-Fi changes nothing.

stats.label: Buttons on the device, no app needed to start

blocks.heading: Built for the way you actually leave the house.
blocks.body: A daily commute, a weekend away, a second home you visit once a month: Kevin follows the routine you set.

blocks.image_alt: Kevin switches on when you leave for work
blocks.title: Every working day
blocks.body: Geofencing starts Kevin when you leave and stops it when you return. The house never has the dark, silent look that says nobody is home.

blocks.title: Holidays and weekends
blocks.body: Set the holiday schedule before you go. Evening after evening the light comes on, shadows move and the TV mutters, with no lamp on a timer at the same time every night.

blocks.image_alt: Several Kevin devices managed in one app
blocks.title: Second homes and rentals
blocks.body: Put a Kevin in the chalet, the holiday flat or the office and manage them all from one app. Because scenes play locally, weak Wi-Fi on site is not a problem.

blocks.heading: Burglars choose the easy, empty-looking house. Yours is not it.
blocks.body: Most break-ins are opportunistic. A home that glows, moves and sounds occupied gets skipped for one that does not. Kevin makes that decision for them before the door is ever tested.

blocks.title: Homes, flats, offices and shops
blocks.body: Kevin covers one room per device. Place it where the street looks in: the living room, a ground-floor window, a shop front after hours. Larger homes or several facades: add a second unit and manage both in the app.

about-kevin.title: About
about-kevin.heading: We build prevention, not surveillance. Swiss engineering for homes that look lived-in.
about-kevin.lede: Mitipi AG in Fribourg develops Kevin, the presence simulator that makes homes, flats, offices and holiday properties look occupied from the street. Since 2018, one idea: stop the break-in before it starts, without a camera watching your family.
about-kevin.image_alt: Kevin presence simulation in a living room at night

seo.title: About Mitipi: the Swiss company behind Kevin | Mitipi
seo.description: Mitipi AG, Fribourg, Switzerland, develops Kevin, a presence simulator that deters burglary with light, moving shadows and sound. Founded 2018. No cameras, no microphones, engineered in Switzerland.

blocks.heading: Everyone deserves to leave home without the second thought.
blocks.body: After a break-in, most people never feel quite safe at home again. We started Mitipi to change how burglary is prevented: not by recording it, but by making sure it is never attempted.

blocks.title: Prevention, not surveillance
blocks.body: Deterrence should not cost your privacy. Kevin has no camera and no microphone. Every scene is stored on the device and plays locally, so nothing about your home is streamed, shared or lost when Wi-Fi is jammed.

blocks.heading: From an idea in Zurich to homes across Europe.
blocks.body: Kevin was conceived in Zurich. Mitipi was founded in 2018 and is now based at Bluefactory in Fribourg, developing each generation of Kevin with Swiss partners.

blocks.title: The idea
blocks.body: Work begins on a device that makes a home look lived-in with light, moving shadows and sound, instead of watching it with a camera.

blocks.title: Kevin launches in Switzerland
blocks.body: The first Kevin ships to Swiss households. Mitipi wins the Global Digital Insurance Agenda (DIA) award for innovation.

blocks.title: Kevin.2
blocks.body: Own recordings and geofencing arrive. Mitipi moves to Bluefactory in Fribourg and receives the Plus X Award in Germany.

blocks.title: Kevin.3
blocks.body: New hardware, 32 GB of on-device storage, more scenes and personalisation. The generation sold on this site.

blocks.title: European Security Award
blocks.body: Mitipi receives the European Security Award for the most innovative burglary prevention in Europe.

blocks.title: Tested, not just claimed
blocks.body: In January 2026 Galaxus tested Kevin.3 and called it “unrivalled in that it’s an easy-to-use, all-in-one solution that delivers a truly spectacular show.” We publish the limits too: one room per device, placement matters, and Kevin deters rather than raises an alarm.

setup-guide.title: Setup guide
setup-guide.heading: Set up Kevin in four steps and check the result from your own pavement.
setup-guide.lede: For new owners: where to place Kevin, how to pair the app once, and how to see what a passer-by sees after dark. No tools, no wiring.

seo.title: Kevin setup guide: placement, pairing, first test | Mitipi
seo.description: Set up Kevin in four steps: place it by a street-facing window with a wall for shadows, pair the app over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, choose a schedule or geofencing, then test from outside after dark.

blocks.heading: Four steps to a home that looks lived-in.
blocks.body: Placement makes the biggest difference. Take a minute to get the window right before you pair the app.

blocks.title: Unbox and place
blocks.body: Put Kevin near a window that can be seen from the street, with a wall or ceiling behind it for the shadows. Connect the power adapter.

blocks.title: Pair the app
blocks.body: Download the Kevin app for iOS or Android and connect over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. Name your device and let it install the latest update.

blocks.title: Choose a routine
blocks.body: Start a simulation right away, set a weekly schedule, or switch on geofencing so Kevin starts when you leave. The three buttons on the device also start a scene without the app.

blocks.title: Test from outside
blocks.body: After dark, step onto the pavement and look at your window. You should see warm, changing light and moving shadows, and hear the room when you get close to the door.

blocks.heading: Where Kevin works best.
blocks.body: Kevin covers one room. Choose the window a burglar would check first: the living room, the ground floor, the side facing the street.

blocks.image_alt: Kevin shadow scene visible through a window at night
blocks.title: Give the shadows a surface
blocks.body: Shadows need a wall or ceiling to land on and curtains or blinds to show through. Sheer curtains work best; heavy blackout curtains hide the effect.

blocks.image_alt: Geofencing settings in the Kevin app
blocks.title: Start with geofencing
blocks.body: For daily use, geofencing is the routine that needs no remembering: Kevin starts when your phone leaves the area and stops when you are back. Use schedules for holidays and for a home you manage from afar.

blocks.heading: Setup FAQ
blocks.body: Answers to what new owners ask most.

blocks.question: Does Kevin need Wi-Fi to run?
blocks.answer: No. Wi-Fi or Bluetooth is only used to set up Kevin and install updates. Scenes play from the 32 GB inside the device, so Kevin keeps working when the network is down or jammed.

blocks.question: Can I add my own sounds?
blocks.answer: Yes. Record familiar household sounds in the app and Kevin mixes them into its scenes. Built-in voices are in English, German and Swiss German.

blocks.question: Something is not working. What now?
blocks.answer: Note the serial number on the bottom of the device and email us. Kevin comes with a 3-year Swiss warranty and 30-day returns.

blocks.title: Warranty and service
blocks.body: Kevin includes a 3-year Swiss warranty and 30-day returns. If your device stops working, contact us with the serial number and a short description, and we will arrange repair or replacement.
